verified_facts.text: Rooms are vaguely Art Deco, with Sofitel MyBeds, dusty-pink headboards and extra-deep soaking tubs.
verified_facts.excerpt: The vaguely Art Deco rooms lull guests into a post-shopping stupor; think, plush Sofitel MyBeds, dusty-pink headboards, extra-deep soaking tubs, and near-uncanny soundproofing.

verified_facts.text: Holism, the hotel's spa, offers LED light therapy alongside traditional treatments.
verified_facts.excerpt: Holism, the pristine spa, features LED light therapy alongside traditional treatments.

verified_facts.text: Guest rooms are stocked with toiletries by Balmain.

verified_facts.text: Altus is an onsite bar and restaurant with an upscale-European menu.
verified_facts.excerpt: Also onsite Altus, a bar and restaurant with a conventional upscale-European menu.
Wi-Fi is free and reliably fast.
